# uses transform codec

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usesTransformCodec`](gmeow-usesTransformCodec.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usesTransformCodec>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

A transform codec declared in a segment's catalog and used by at least one of its frames (spec §8). Non-functional: payloads carry stackable codec chains.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) -> [`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usesTransformCodec`](gmeow-usesTransformCodec.md) from [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) to [`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
